title: Light and Darkness Theme
summary: Light and Darkness Theme is a biblical motif that traces revelation and moral contrast across Scripture.
historical_context: Light and Darkness Theme is read across the canon as Scripture develops this theme from Israel's story into the New Testament witness.

literary_context: The topic appears in narrative, poetry, prophecy, Gospel, epistle, and apocalyptic writing as context requires.
